title: Joint Point-Distality and structure theory for commuting actions
summary: Let $G$ and $H$ act commutatively and minimally on a compact metrizable space $X$. We prove that if the two subactions are point-distal, equivalently HPI, then the action generated by them is again point-distal. We also construct a common highly proximal extension on which both subactions are strictly HPI. As consequences, transitivity of mixed products and linear iterates upgrades to minimality in the point-distal category.
